rules.name: Base/CodeQuality
content: Follow Kotlin coding conventions and Android architecture guidelines (MVVM).
Use meaningful variable and function names.
Prefer immutable data structures and coroutines for asynchronous operations.
Write comprehensive JSDoc/KDoc comments for all public APIs.
Update README files for new features and include usage examples.

rules.name: Base/Testing
content: Write unit tests for all new features with 80%+ code coverage.
Use mock objects for dependencies and test error conditions.
Write integration tests for service interactions and cross-module integration.
Test on Xiaomi Pad 7 Ultra (primary Android target) and iPad (primary iOS target).

rules.name: Base/Performance
content: Monitor memory usage and implement proper garbage collection.
Use streaming processing for large files and implement memory limits.
Use appropriate thread counts and implement thermal management.
Minimize background processing and optimize for mobile devices.

rules.name: Security/ToolAllowList
content: ALLOW ONLY: readFiles, searchInWorkspace, writeFiles, runTests.
readFiles: max_lines_per_read=250; EXCLUDE node_modules, .git, dist, build.
writeFiles: only files listed in ```verify```; show ```diffplan``` first.
runTests: must run before commit.
Shell/network/package-managers are DISALLOWED unless the ```task``` block includes Network: APPROVED.

rules.name: Security/TriggerClassifier
content: Before any write or external command proposal (Gradle, ADB, permission grants, broadcasts, MediaStore mutations, file ops), output:
```triggercheck
PlannedCommands: <verbatim gradle/adb/content lines or N/A>
Categories: <ADB|GRADLE|LOGCAT|BROADCAST|FS|MEDIASTORE|PERMISSIONS|PROC|DEVICE|NETWORK|DEBUG>
DetectedPatterns: <short tags>
PolicyIntent: <category -> OBSERVE|REVIEW|APPROVAL_RECOMMENDED>

rules.name: Security/ComplianceReport
content: After printing ```diffplan``` (and optionally executing commands), save:
- .cursor.commands.txt (from triggercheck.PlannedCommands)
- .cursor.diffplan.txt (from diffplan)
Then run (SOFT): `node scripts/compliance-check.js --diffplan .cursor.diffplan.txt --commands .cursor.commands.txt --risk <LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH> --strict false`
Paste the emitted report back as a fenced block:
```compliance
<checker output>
Proceed regardless of result (soft mode). If score is HIGH-RISK, recommend manual review.

rules.name: Android/ScopedStorage
content: FORBID raw /sdcard usage in code changes. Prefer app-private dirs and content URI/FD streaming loaders for model/media I/O.
JNI loaders accept FDs; do not open absolute external paths.
All file/media I/O must be capability-based (content URI -> FD). All model loads must use app-private absolute paths from DLStorage.resolveModelPath().

rules.name: Android/MediaStorePolicy
content: Any `content insert|update|delete` must appear in ```triggercheck``` and the Compliance Report.
MediaStore queries should use proper projection and where clauses.
File sharing must use FileProvider with proper authority configuration.

rules.name: Android/BuildAndDeviceOps
content: Classify GRADLE (`assemble|bundle|install|connectedAndroidTest`) and ADB (`am start|startservice|broadcast`, `pm grant`, `svc` toggles).
LOGCAT/dumpsys/getprop reads are fine but still classify.
Device operations (input tap, input text) require explicit approval.
Permission grants must be documented and justified.

rules.name: Android/ServiceArchitecture
content: Use foreground services for long-running operations.
Implement proper service lifecycle management.
Use WorkManager for background tasks.
Implement proper error handling and recovery mechanisms.

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Policy
content: All Android file I/O MUST go through MiraStorageService (scoped-storage compliant).
Prohibit direct java.io/java.nio file APIs and absolute external paths.
App code: use MiraStorageService APIs (URI/FD based) for read/write/exists/list.
JNI/native: receive and use file descriptors (FD) supplied by MiraStorageService; disallow fopen/open on paths.

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/HowTo
content: Refactor pattern:
BEFORE (bad): new File(path), FileInputStream(path), Files.readAllBytes(path), RandomAccessFile(path,'r'), Paths.get(path), '/sdcard/...', Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().
AFTER (good):
- Kotlin: uri: Uri -> MiraStorage.openReadFd(uri) / MiraStorage.openWriteFd(uri) / MiraStorage.readBytes(uri) / MiraStorage.writeBytes(uri, data)
- JNI: accept fd (int) or AParcelFileDescriptor; use read(2)/write(2)/mmap on FD only; never fopen(path).

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Detection
content: When proposing changes that touch storage or JNI I/O, output a ```triggercheck``` with Categories including: FS, MEDIASTORE.

DetectedPatterns must list any usages of: java.io.File, FileInputStream/OutputStream, RandomAccessFile, java.nio.file.Files, Paths.get, Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory, '/sdcard', JNI fopen/open.

rules.name: Project/VideoEditor
content: This is a multi-platform video processing application combining CLIP video clipping and Whisper audio transcription.
Target platforms: Android (Xiaomi Pad 7 Ultra), iOS (iPad), macOS web.
Primary focus: Real-time video processing with ML models and audio transcription.

rules.name: Project/StorageArchitecture
content: Use DLStorage interface for all storage operations.
Models must be installed to app-private storage and accessed via absolute paths.
User media must be accessed via content URIs and file descriptors.
Implement proper SHA-256 validation for model integrity.

rules.name: Project/MLModels
content: CLIP Processing: Frame processing <0.1s per frame, Memory usage <200MB peak, Accuracy 95%+.
Whisper Processing: RTF <0.1, Memory usage <100MB peak, Accuracy 95%+.
Use GGUF format for Whisper models.
Implement proper model loading and context management.

rules.name: Project/Testing
content: When touching ClipEngines or VideoIngestWorker, run instrumented tests.
When modifying database entities or DAOs, run unit tests.
When changing ML models or encoders, run all tests.
When modifying workers, run instrumented tests.
When changing video processing, run frame sampler tests.

rules.name: Local/Development
content: Local development overrides and personal preferences.
Can override any higher-level rule for development convenience.
Should not be committed to version control.

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Policy
content: All Android file I/O MUST go through MiraStorageService (scoped-storage compliant).
FORBID: Direct file path manipulation via ADB commands, app-internal storage access, or bypassing Android security model.
App code: use MiraStorageService APIs (URI/FD based) for read/write/exists/list.
JNI/native: receive and use file descriptors (FD) supplied by MiraStorageService; disallow fopen/open on paths.
ADB commands: NEVER manipulate app-internal storage directly; use app's proper interfaces instead.

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/ADB_Prohibition
content: FORBID these ADB storage manipulation patterns:
- mkdir /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files
- cp /sdcard/* /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files/
- touch /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files/*
- rm /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files/*
- Any direct manipulation of app-internal storage paths
REQUIRED: Use app's file picker, MiraStorageService APIs, or content:// URIs instead.

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/HowTo
content: Refactor pattern:
BEFORE (bad):
- new File(path), FileInputStream(path), Files.readAllBytes(path)
- RandomAccessFile(path,'r'), Paths.get(path)
- '/sdcard/...', Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()
- adb shell 'mkdir /data/user/0/app/files'
- adb shell 'cp /sdcard/file /data/user/0/app/files/'
AFTER (good):
- Kotlin: uri: Uri -> MiraStorage.openReadFd(uri) / MiraStorage.openWriteFd(uri)
- Kotlin: MiraStorage.readBytes(uri) / MiraStorage.writeBytes(uri, data)
- JNI: accept fd (int) or AParcelFileDescriptor; use read(2)/write(2)/mmap on FD only
- ADB: Use app's file picker UI or content:// URIs for file access

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Detection
content: When proposing changes that touch storage or JNI I/O, output a ```triggercheck``` with Categories including: FS, MEDIASTORE, ADB_STORAGE.
DetectedPatterns must list any usages of:
- java.io.File, FileInputStream/OutputStream, RandomAccessFile
- java.nio.file.Files, Paths.get, Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory
- '/sdcard', JNI fopen/open
- adb shell mkdir/cp/touch/rm /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files
- Any direct app-internal storage manipulation via ADB

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Test_Strategy
content: Test strategy MUST follow MiraStorage policy:
- Use app's file picker UI for file selection
- Trigger processing through proper app interfaces
- Use content:// URIs for file access
- NEVER manipulate app-internal storage directly via ADB
- Test MiraStorageService APIs, not direct file system access
- Use app's WebView interface or proper Android intents
